sentence: NHS pages link bone health to weight-bearing exercise, calcium, vitamin D, not smoking and keeping alcohol low; inactivity raises osteoporosis risk.
note: NHS prevention page: exercise, calcium, vitamin D, avoid smoking and heavy drinking; inactivity raises risk

sentence: NHS guidance treats weight-bearing and resistance exercise as the most useful activity for bone strength.
note: Weight-bearing and resistance exercise most useful

sentence: Calcium is important for bone health, and vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium.
note: Calcium important; vitamin D helps absorb calcium

sentence: Being inactive, being under or over weight, smoking and heavy drinking are listed as risk factors for weaker bones.
note: Inactivity, low or high weight, smoking, heavy drinking

sentence: The NHS advises adults aged 65 and over to include strength and balance activities on at least two days a week.
note: Strength, balance, flexibility at least 2 days a week for older adults

sentence: NHS guidance treats weight-bearing and resistance exercise as the most useful activities for bone density.
note: Weight-bearing and resistance exercise most useful for bone density

sentence: Running, skipping, dancing, aerobics and jumping are named as higher-impact examples that strengthen muscles, ligaments and joints.
note: High-impact options like running, skipping, dancing, aerobics, jumping

sentence: Swimming and cycling support general fitness but are not weight-bearing, so they do less for the bones.
note: Swimming and cycling are not weight-bearing

sentence: Being inactive makes muscles and bones lose strength, which raises the risk of osteoporosis, falls and fractures.
note: Inactive makes muscles and bones lose strength; risk of osteoporosis, falls and fractures

sentence: The NHS says calcium is important for maintaining bone health.
note: Calcium is important for maintaining bone health

sentence: Vitamin D helps the body absorb calcium, and the NHS osteoporosis page suggests a daily supplement containing 10 micrograms of vitamin D for people at risk.
note: Vitamin D helps body absorb calcium; daily supplement 10 micrograms

sentence: Sunlight helps too, but all adults are advised to consider a daily vitamin D supplement, particularly from October to March.
note: Sunlight helps; all adults consider supplement particularly during winter months (October to March)

sentence: Being underweight or overweight is listed as a risk for osteopenia, the stage of bone loss before osteoporosis, and for broken bones.
note: Being under or overweight increases risk of osteopenia and breaking a bone

sentence: Smoking and heavy drinking are also listed, and one source gives the low-risk alcohol guidance of less than 14 units a week.
note: Avoid cigarette smoke and keep alcohol to less than 14 units per week

sentence: A high-salt diet is flagged in one source because sodium increases the calcium lost in urine.
note: High-salt diet flagged: sodium increases urinary losses of calcium

sentence: NHS guidance for people aged 65 and over advises activities that improve strength, balance and flexibility on at least two days a week.
note: Strength balance flexibility on at least 2 days a week for over 65

sentence: It also advises about 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity a week, built up gradually from current levels.
The NHS advises anyone diagnosed with osteoporosis to talk to a GP or specialist before starting a new exercise programme.
note: If diagnosed with osteoporosis talk to GP or specialist before starting new exercise

sentence: A DEXA bone density scan is the standard test for bone loss.
note: DEXA bone density scan is the standard test
